class.name: IfcProperty
class.brief_description: IfcProperty is an abstract generalization for all types of properties that can be associated with IFC objects through the property set mechanism. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 1.0.

members.member: Name for this property. This label is the significant name string that defines the semantic meaning for the property. A String, or null when unset.
In IFC2X3 and IFC4 files, this is the [code]Description[/code] attribute. A String, or null when unset.
Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it is empty.
